words.prose: {{ar:تَذْكِرَةٌ}} ({{tr:tadhkiratun}}) is the predicate that names what the defended revelation is: a reminder, an admonitory object, and an instrument that causes remembrance. The following {{ar:لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ}} ({{tr:li-l-muttaqīna}}) prevents the noun from staying abstract by routing its active force toward the guarding audience. The Form II pattern, including doubled-consonant causative pressure, and the lexical evidence make the reminder causative and usable, not merely a passive store of memory; the broader {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) branches for maleness or hardness are not locally selected. The non-surface response-form background sharpens the word as what should provoke taking heed, while the local surface remains the Form II reminder noun. Within the surah, the word answers the failure to remember in 69:42 and joins the earlier reminder-sign in 69:12, so the revelation itself becomes the supplied reminder for those able to receive it; across self-referential reminder uses such as 73:19, 74:54, and 80:11, this formula becomes specially audience-directed here.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) is the small word that turns reminder into reminder-for. It governs {{ar:الْمُتَّقِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqīna}}) and attaches the final phrase to {{ar:تَذْكِرَةٌ}} ({{tr:tadhkiratun}}), so the ayah does not make two separate claims about a reminder and a group; it names a reminder whose effective benefit is specified by that group. The preposition keeps benefit and specification together: the guarding ones are the people for whom the reminder works, without needing to claim that nobody else can hear it. Because the phrase comes after the emphatic predicate, the ayah first asserts what the revelation is and then narrows who receives its benefit. That effective-recipient profile also contrasts with the disbelieving profile in 69:33, where rejection rather than guarded reception defines the person. In the pronounced form {{ar:لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ}} ({{tr:li-l-muttaqīna}}), the preposition and definite audience noun are visibly and audibly fused.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 2 is joined by li- to the self-guarding recipients at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder restores a matter to active awareness, while the recipients are defined by placing themselves in protective caution. Recollection is therefore not an endpoint but the input that makes self-guarding possible.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to mind supplies the mnemonic operation performed by the reminder.
A thing that causes recall makes the focus noun an active instrument rather than stored information.
Placing oneself in protective caution identifies the recipients by an enacted response to what is recalled.

changed_reading.before: A message that reminds already-pious people.
changed_reading.after: An instrument that restores a matter to awareness so its hearers can actively place themselves in protective caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reminder at word 2 can be voiced, and the audience-name at word 3 retains the image of warding harm with a barrier.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mention carried on the tongue keeps the recalled matter socially present; that repeated presence can function as a guard between the hearer and harm. The verse can thus name a spoken protective practice, not only a private mental event.

activation_trace.role: Mention flowing on the tongue supplies the repeatable public action of the reminder.
Warding harm by a barrier gives that voiced mention a protective function.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is content received by cautious people.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is a repeatable utterance whose maintained presence helps form a barrier against harmful action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots permit a hard or sharp signal at word 2 and a pain-aware guarded gait at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe reminder makes the terrain morally palpable, while the recipients advance by testing where they place weight. The focus may portray attentiveness as altered movement through danger rather than as static possession of virtue.

activation_trace.role: Hardness, sharpness, and force make the reminder a severe contact signal.
Guarded movement over a painful surface models the recipients as continually adjusting their steps.

changed_reading.before: The cautious are a settled class who understand a reminder.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is a hard warning surface that produces a careful, repeatedly corrected way of moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath activates the focus root's document-of-right branch: the reminder can be heard as an authenticated instrument that places a claim before people concerned with protective accountability.

activation_trace.role: A written instrument of right supplies the documentary potential inside the focus noun.
Self-protective caution makes the audience responsive to the liability recorded by such an instrument.
An oath apportioned to its addressees supplies authentication and directs the claim toward the audience.

structural_cues: The oath opens the same discourse that later predicates tadhkira of the revelation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rights-instrument image and an oath image; I infer that the oath authenticates the reminder as evidence, while a live alternative is that it only intensifies attention.

changed_reading.before: A mnemonic exhortation offered to receptive hearers.
changed_reading.after: A sworn, inspectable instrument that records a claim and summons the audience to protective accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired domains of what is seen and not seen revise recall into an epistemic bridge. The reminder keeps both sensory evidence and inwardly apprehended reality concurrently available so caution is not limited to immediate visibility.

activation_trace.role: Recollection keeps a matter present even when it is not currently before the eye.
Protective caution converts expanded awareness into a guarded response.
Eyesight supplies the explicitly visible evidentiary field.
Inner discernment supplies a mode of apprehension for what the visible field does not contain.

structural_cues: The coordinated contrast between what you see and what you do not see precedes the focus predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ocular sight, inner discernment, and an explicit seen/unseen contrast; I infer that reminder holds the two fields together, though the alternative is that the contrast only enlarges the oath's scope.

changed_reading.before: The reminder retrieves a previously known proposition.
changed_reading.after: The reminder trains protective awareness to range across both present perception and realities available only to inward discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is relocated from an autonomous mental cue into a transmission event: utterance is borne as a message by an honorable envoy. Its protective force includes a relation of source, carriage, and trustworthy reception.

activation_trace.role: Verbal mention anchors the focus reminder in actual utterance.
The protective barrier image supplies the consequence sought through reliable reception.
Speech brought out in articulation makes the reminder a sounded event.
Messenger and message supply the carriage relation between origin and hearer.
Praiseworthy honor marks the carrier as fit for the entrusted speech.

structural_cues: The emphatic predication of the discourse as an honorable messenger's speech precedes the identical emphatic predication as a reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies articulated speech, message-carriage, and honorable standing; I infer that provenance is part of how the reminder protects, while the alternative is that these details defend origin without changing its recipient-side function.

changed_reading.before: A reminder whose content alone prompts caution.
changed_reading.after: An honorably entrusted utterance whose traceable transmission is itself part of the hearer's grounds for guarded response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The excluded poetic and hidden-news classifications, followed by the scarcity of settled belief and active recollection, make the focus reminder diagnostic. It does not merely supply absent content; it exposes whether a hearer will classify the signal rightly and retrieve what it presents.

activation_trace.role: The reminder image supplies the focus signal whose reception is tested.
Self-placement in caution identifies the positive reception mode.
The explicitly negated poetic category supplies one rejected classification of the speech.
Smallness and paucity quantify the weak uptake of the signal.
Heart-settling assent supplies one reception act reported as scarce.
The explicitly negated claimant to hidden reports supplies the second rejected classification.
Repeated paucity links weak assent to weak recollective response.
Active retrieval after lapse supplies the response reported as occurring too little.

structural_cues: Parallel negations of two speech genres are followed by parallel clauses of scarce assent and scarce recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two excluded classifications and two scarce reception acts; I infer that misclassification helps block retrieval, while the alternative is that the four clauses are independent defenses and reproaches.

changed_reading.before: The reminder benefits a pre-existing class of cautious recipients.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is also a reception test that reveals who will classify, retrieve, and act on the signal rather than explain it away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent becomes delivery, lordship becomes cultivation and growth, and the worlds-root supplies a distinguishing mark. Together they activate the reminder as provision deliberately delivered to grow protective capacity and leave a recognizable orientation in the recipient.

activation_trace.role: The reminder supplies the formative provision being delivered.
Self-protective caution is the capacity that the provision cultivates.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies intentional delivery.
Correction, nurture, and completion make delivery pedagogically formative.
The non-dominant mapped image of feeding and growth makes the recipient's protective capacity developmental.
A distinguishing trace that guides toward its referent makes the cultivated orientation recognizable.

structural_cues: The nominal descent clause immediately follows the speech-origin contrasts and precedes the warning sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, nurture, growth, and a guiding mark; I infer a developmental chain from delivered reminder to cultivated caution, while the alternative is that these images characterize only source and cosmos.

changed_reading.before: A reminder encountered as a completed verbal object.
changed_reading.after: Delivered formative provision that grows a protective disposition and leaves the recipient oriented by a distinguishing mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possibility of attributing even a portion of invented sayings activates the focus reminder as an integrity-sensitive instrument of right. Its authority is not averaged across mostly true material; a fabricated insertion would breach the whole transmission claim.

activation_trace.role: The deed or rights-document image makes textual integrity legally consequential.
A protective barrier models the integrity boundary that cannot admit fabrication.
Saying what did not exist supplies the exact form of tampering under the counterfactual.
Partition into a portion shows that even partial invention is material to the instrument's status.

structural_cues: The counterfactual names only some sayings, yet the following sanction is total and bodily.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invented attribution, a partial segment, and a rights-document/barrier potential; I infer tamper-evident integrity, while the alternative is that the sanction concerns the messenger alone rather than the reminder's whole-text status.

changed_reading.before: A generally trustworthy reminder whose central teaching protects.
changed_reading.after: An integrity-sensitive instrument whose protective and evidentiary force excludes even a partial fabricated insertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seizure by force, severance of the life-artery, universal negation, and the absence of any intervening barrier sharply qualify the focus protection image. The reminder protects by enabling prior alignment and careful conduct, not by furnishing immunity once decisive accountability arrives.

activation_trace.role: The reminder supplies the advance intervention before the cutoff sequence.
Warding harm by a barrier is the focus image that the context tests and limits.
Putting oneself in caution relocates effective protection to conduct before seizure.
Grasping and capture initiate the irreversible enforcement sequence.
Right-side force and rightful power characterize the seizure as authoritative rather than accidental.
Severing and separation supply the terminal action against false transmission.
The life-artery makes that severance a cutoff of the sustaining line itself.
Exhaustive negation removes every possible human exception.
Interposition by a separating barrier names precisely what no audience member could supply.

structural_cues: The then-sequence moves from seizure to severance to the denial of any intervenor immediately before the focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, rightful force, life-cutoff, exhaustive negation, and failed interposition; I infer that focus protection operates prospectively through alignment, while the alternative is that the sequence authenticates the messenger without redefining protective caution.

changed_reading.before: The reminder itself stands as a shield that keeps its recipients from harm.
changed_reading.after: The reminder enables protective alignment before judgment, while explicitly offering no shield against enforcement after deliberate falsification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Known deniers remain inside the addressed 'among you.' The focus designation of the self-guarding therefore does not simply describe an external audience; the reminder operates within a mixed field and makes opposed responses legible.

activation_trace.role: The reminder supplies the common signal before which responses diverge.
Self-guarding supplies one response-category generated around the common signal.
A distinguishing trace that points to its object makes divergent reception detectable.
Assigning the message or speaker to falsehood supplies the opposed reception-category.

structural_cues: The focus recipients and the deniers are both grammatically located in relation to the same second-person plural audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies known deniers among the audience and a branch for a distinguishing trace; I infer that the reminder sorts by manifested response, while the alternative is that the verse merely reports two already fixed groups.

changed_reading.before: A reminder reserved for a separately identified pious group.
changed_reading.after: A common signal in a mixed audience that exposes and distinguishes self-guarding reception from active falsification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers protective covering, whereas the next verse joins regret to those who cover the truth. The uncovering and bare-without-protection branches turn the relation into a reversal: concealment looks like cover now but ends by stripping cover away.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that genuinely wards harm supplies the valid kind of cover.
Deliberate self-placement in caution explains how the valid cover is entered.
Removing a covering supplies the reversal that reveals concealment's failure.
Being bare of protection names the resulting state after the false cover is removed.
Grief over what escaped supplies the affective consequence of exposure too late.
Covering and concealment supply the counterfeit protective strategy.
Veiling the truth specifies what the counterfeit cover attempts to hide.

structural_cues: The same emphatic pronominal frame predicates reminder in 69:48 and regret in 69:50 of the same discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genuine protection, concealment, uncovering, nakedness, and regret; I infer an intentional contrast between true and counterfeit covers, while the alternative is that the adjacent predicates describe unrelated audience effects.

changed_reading.before: The self-guarding accept protection while rejecters simply feel regret.
changed_reading.after: The reminder distinguishes a cover that truly guards from a concealment that only delays exposure and ultimately leaves its user unprotected.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth fixed to reality and knowledge cleared of doubt convert reminder from mere repetition into re-alignment. It restores the claim to the place where it fits reality, with tight verbal construction functioning like a warrant for settled knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Restoring something to mind supplies the cognitive movement toward alignment.
The instrument-of-right image gives recalled content an evidentiary rather than merely nostalgic force.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard to which recollection returns the hearer.
Tight construction in weaving or speech makes the discourse's form part of its evidentiary fit.
A part matching its proper joint or vessel models exact placement rather than generic truthfulness.
Knowledge stabilized after doubt supplies the resulting epistemic state.

structural_cues: The emphatic predication progresses from reminder to regret to the truth of certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reality-correspondence, tight construction, proper fit, and doubt-free knowledge; I infer that reminder re-seats the hearer in that fit, while the alternative is that certainty is only a separate assertion about the text.

changed_reading.before: The reminder makes a known teaching mentally present again.
changed_reading.after: The reminder re-aligns cognition with a tightly fitted reality until protective action can rest on settled knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command moves from inner recollection to voiced response: clearing false attribution and naming the exalted referent. The focus reminder thus completes itself in an outward act that keeps the right name and distinction publicly present.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue supplies the outward completion latent in the focus reminder.
Honorable mention and renown give public naming a reputational dimension.
Clearing and declaring free of defect supplies the commanded verbal response.
A name that makes known and points out supplies the public referential act.

structural_cues: The pericope ends with an imperative to voice transcendence through the Lord's name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal clearing, name-as-indication, and tongue-borne mention; I infer that the reminder seeks performative naming, while the alternative is that the command is a coda addressed only to the messenger.

changed_reading.before: A reminder whose successful effect remains inward caution.
changed_reading.after: A reminder that culminates in publicly naming and clearing its referent, carrying protected recollection back into speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two narrow, form-distant focus branches: a rights document and a named unit of weight. It remains packet-anchored in both focus roots and sharpens the audience's accountability, but downstream prose should present it only as a legal-metrological resonance, not as the lexical sense of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus words can activate an auditable instrument: the reminder as a document of right and the recipients' root as a known measure.

activation_trace.role: A deed recording a right turns the reminder into an inspectable claim-bearing instrument.
A fixed unit of weight contributes the exploratory image of measured liability and exact accounting.

changed_reading.before: An admonition aimed at morally cautious people.
changed_reading.after: An auditable instrument that both records a right and evokes the exact weighing of the recipient's liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from qawl to the q-l-l branch of independently carrying and rising with a load. It remains anchored by the focus images of a hard reminder and guarded gait, but prose should mark it as a cross-root activation rather than claim that 'speech' lexically means burden here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hard reminder and guarded-gait branches in the focus allow transmitted speech to be experienced as weight that changes how its recipient rises and walks.

activation_trace.role: Hardness and force give the reminder the felt resistance of a serious load.
Guarded gait supplies the recipient's altered movement under that load.
The non-dominant mapped image of independently carrying and rising supplies the abductive bridge from received speech to shouldered responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's speech is heard and then remembered.
changed_reading.after: The speech is shouldered as responsibility: its hard reminder makes the cautious recipient rise and move differently.

strongest_changes: The reminder became a prospective form of protection that works through alignment before the context's irreversible seizure and cutoff, not an immunity from judgment.
The adjacent cover/uncover branches distinguished self-guarding as genuine cover from concealment of truth as a counterfeit cover that ends in exposure.
The context made the reminder provenance-sensitive and tamper-evident: honorable transmission and the exclusion of even partial fabrication belong to its protective force.
Truth, exact fit, and certainty revised recollection into cognitive re-alignment with reality rather than mere repetition of familiar content.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported several coexisting material models: mnemonic retrieval feeding caution, voiced mention forming a barrier, hard warning producing guarded movement, and an exploratory rights instrument. Context did not collapse these; it authenticated, transmitted, tested, cultivated, limited, inverted, and finally voiced them.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from reminder to protection is reader-supplied; the grammar also permits a reminder that benefits people already characterized by self-guarding.
The document, measure, guarded-gait, and load-bearing images are packet-resolved but branch-distant and should remain exploratory.
The seen/unseen pairing may define the oath's scope without making the reminder itself an epistemic bridge.
The final naming command may describe the messenger's response rather than the downstream action of every cautious recipient.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reminder functions as protective equipment.** **ذ ك ر B009** (reminder or admonition) is assigned to **و ق ي B002** (placing the self in protective caution). The packet supplies the informational object and the receptive class; I infer that recollection enables anticipatory self-guarding. The ayah reads as a causal protection mechanism, not merely a label for edifying speech.
2. **The reminder repeats the preserved-event function.** The same **ذ ك ر B009** occurred in 69:12 after bodily rescue, now joined to **و ق ي B001** (warding harm off with a protective barrier). The packet supplies two `تذكرة` nodes and intervening judgment scenes; I infer that the preserved narrative becomes a nonmaterial barrier against repeating the earlier failures. Memory and protection remain distinct stages.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:49 reveals the reminder's divisive reception: its protective function remains available even while some hearers actively reject it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The reminder is a guarded legal instrument as well as admonition.** `ذ ك ر` B009 is "reminder or admonition," while B008 is "rights document or legal instrument." The descent is source-authenticated in 69:43, protected by the anti-fabrication sanction in 69:44-47, and affirmed as certain truth in 69:51. B009 supplies corrective content; B008 assigns the protected text the role of an operative record of claims and liabilities. The packet supplies custody, sanction, and truth-status; I infer authentication -> legal force. `تَذْكِرَةٌ` therefore reads as admonition with documentary consequence.
2. **Protection moves from an impossible external barrier to internal caution.** `و ق ي` B001 is "warding harm off with a protective barrier," while B002 is "placing the self in protective caution." Immediately before, 69:47 denies any `حَاجِز` capable of externally blocking enforcement. B001 supplies the protective function; B002 relocates it into the recipient's prior self-positioning through the reminder. The packet gives no rescue-barrier after breach but a reminder for the cautious; I infer reminder -> self-guarding -> harm averted before enforcement. `لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ` reads as proactive protection, not privileged labeling.
3. **Remembering is the mechanism that keeps caution active.** `ذ ك ر` B003 is "bringing a thing to mind." The closing sequence moves from reminder to known deniers, regret, certain truth, and praise. B003 assigns repeated mental availability to the message; `و ق ي` B002 assigns the resulting behavioral posture. The packet supplies cognition and protection but not their arrow; I infer retained reminder -> sustained caution. The ayah reads as a functional account of how the text protects its recipients.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:50 shows that the same reminder becomes regret upon rejecters, while 69:51 leaves its truth-status unchanged. This later divergence corrects any idea that `تَذْكِرَةٌ` mechanically protects every hearer. `و ق ي` B002 requires a receptive self-position; the text remains firm while its relational outcome changes with reception.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Poetry's root reaches hair, vegetation, barley, undergarment, blood-mark, star-name, and segmented meter; divination reaches hidden news, service, and tribal title.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız sözle anma yapısı içinde geçerlidir; içten hatırlama, genel konuşma yetisi ve anılmanın doğurduğu ün ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım açıkça sözle anma yapısına bağlı tutulur; çekiştirme anlamı yalnız insanlardan kusurlarıyla söz etme bağlamında verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi dil aracılığıyla söz konusu etmek, adını söylemek veya sözle görünür kılmaktır. İnsanların kusurlarını arkalarından söyleme, bu eylemin olumsuz bağlama bağlı bir türüdür.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, nesne veya konuyu dilde söz olarak geçirmek ve adını söylemektir.
Söz aracılığıyla bir şeyi bildirme veya görünür kılma yönünü taşır.
İnsanların kusurlarından arkalarında söz etme bağlamında çekiştirme anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin dilde söz olarak geçirilmesini ortak çekirdek sayar; insanları kusurlarıyla anmayı ise bağlama bağlı olumsuz bir kullanım olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, nesne veya konunun dilde adlandırılması ve söz konusu edilmesi gereken yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözle adlandırma, görünür kılma ve bağlama bağlı olumsuz anma alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin adı konuşma içinde geçirildiğinde doğal karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi söz içinde adlandırma ve söz konusu etme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her türlü söz sayılabilen geniş kaynak açıklamasını ve özel çekiştirme kullanımını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın eksik ve kusurlarından o yokken söz etme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanları kusurlarıyla anma biçimindeki olumsuz özel kullanımı korur.
error_profile.loses: Tarafsız veya olumlu sözle anma çekirdeğini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak belirli bir kişi, nesne veya konuyu söz içinde anmayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, belirli bir içeriği anma koşulu olmadan konuşma seslerini dışa vurmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Dile getirme genel bir konuşma eylemidir; sözle anma ise belirli bir içeriği adlandırıp konu etmeye bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir kişiyi en iyi nitelikleriyle överek yüceltme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Övme sırasında kişi olumlu özellikleriyle söz içinde anılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Övme zorunlu olarak olumlu değer yükler; odak dalı ise değer yönü taşımadan yalnız söz konusu etmeyi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak tarafsız ve olumlu sözle anmayı da kapsayan daha geniş bir eylemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kusur arama, küçümseme ve gizli ya da açık saldırı yollarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir kişiyi kusurları üzerinden söz konusu etme bağlamında örtüşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odaktaki olumsuz kullanım arkadan kusur söylemeyle sınırlıdır; komşu daha geniş yerme ve saldırı davranışlarını içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak içeriğin dil aracılığıyla dışa vurulmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu içerik söylenmese bile onun zihinde korunması veya geri çağrılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyi hatırlamak, onun daha sonra sözle anılmasına eşlik edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hatırlama zihinsel bir durum veya süreçtir; sözle anma ise dışa vurulan dilsel eylemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak bir kişi veya şeyden söz etme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu sürekli ve olumlu anılmanın doğurduğu iyi ün, onur ve saygınlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin toplum içinde anılması onun ününün oluşmasına katkı sağlayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tekil dilsel eylemdir; komşu bu tür anmaların toplumsal sonucu olan kalıcı itibardır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ذكر الشيء باللسان والقول والإظهار والتسمية، ومنه ذكر الناس بخير أو بسوء إذا دل السياق.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Tanrı'yı anmaya yönelen kulluk eylemlerini; yakarış, övgü, yüceltme, şükretme, buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma örnekleriyle açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu ibadet odaklı kapsamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her sözlü anma bu dala girmez; eylemin Tanrı'ya yönelmiş bir kulluk, övgü, yakarış veya itaat niteliği taşıması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel kulluk anlamı ile Tanrı'yı anma söz öbeği ayrılır; dinî metin okuma ancak bu kulluk yönelimi içinde değerlendirilir.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı kulluk amacıyla anmak; ona yönelen yakarış, övgü, yüceltme, şükretme, buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma eylemlerini yerine getirmektir.

facets.statement: Tanrı'ya yönelmiş bir kulluk ve bilinçli anma eylemidir.
Yakarış, övgü, yüceltme ve şükretme bu kulluk yöneliminin sözlü veya içsel biçimleridir.
Buyruklara uyma ve dinî metni bu amaçla okuma da aynı kulluk alanında değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar Tanrı'yı anmayı ibadet, yakarış ve övgü ekseninde birleştirir; yüceltme, şükretme, itaat ve dinî metin okumayı bu yönelimin farklı gerçekleşmeleri sayar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'ya yönelen yakarış, övgü, şükür, itaat ve dinî okuma eylemlerini ortak bir kulluk kavramında toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya yönelme koşulunu ve kulluğun sözlü, içsel ve davranışsal biçimlerini korur.

error_profile.loses: Buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma gibi davranışsal gerçekleşmeleri açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kulluğun sözlü yakarış, övgü ve yüceltme yönü bağlamda baskın olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakarış, övgü ve yüceltme biçimindeki kulluk eylemlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Şükretme, itaat ve dinî okuma gibi öteki gerçekleşmeleri kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dini açıklayan kitabı, peygamberlere indirildiğine inanılan kitapları, Kur'an'ı ve önceki kutsal kitapları aynı dalda toplar. Geçici çerçeve metinsel nesneyi doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kutsal veya vahyedilmiş sayılan kitabın kendisidir; okuma, çalışma, ibadet ya da zihinsel hatırlama eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın kutsal kitap anlamını verir; okuma veya ibadetle ilgili söz öbeklerinden yeni bir genel anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dinin hükümlerini ve açıklamalarını içeren, bir peygambere indirildiğine inanılan kutsal kitaptır. Kapsam hem Kur'an'ı hem de daha önceki kutsal kitapları içine alabilir.

facets.statement: Dinin ayrıntılarını bildiren ve ilahi kaynaklı kabul edilen kitaptır.
Kur'an ile ondan önceki peygamberlere bağlanan kutsal kitapları kapsayan bir üst ad olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dini açıklayan peygamber kitaplarını ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve kapsamı Kur'an ile önceki kutsal kitaplara kadar genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinin hükümlerini içeren peygamber kitabı genel bir tür olarak anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini açıklama, kutsal kabul edilme ve peygambere indirilme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam kitabın dini ve vahyedilmiş niteliğini zaten açıkça gösterdiğinde doğal kısa karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini içerikli ve kutsal kabul edilen kitap olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Peygambere indirilme ve önceki kitapları kapsayan üst ad olma ayrıntısını açıkça belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın iyi ün ve onur anlamı korunur; kişi niteleyen söz öbeği bellek gücü ile iyi anılmayı kendi bağlamında birleştirir.

facets.statement: Korunan şeyden zarar verici etkiyi uzak tutma ve onu incinmekten ya da bozulmaktan saklama işlemidir.
